scope: All repository patch files and custom integration boundaries; Android Security Bulletins September through November 2026 kernel and Qualcomm sections.

series.description: Custom interfaces: credential pinning, ReKernel validation/init/parser/netns, Hybrid Mount request snapshots
series.adaptation: Local audit; preserve existing Netlink text and hm1 wire formats.
Keep 4.9 close/unlink under the socket lock. CONFIG_NFC remains disabled on the phone.
4.9 has no separate bufsize parameter; reject zero size in exported raw-event entry point.

Use 4.9 tx_flags/SKBTX_SHARED_FRAG. GRO is in skbuff.c; TCP MTU probing copies data. ESP already always calls skb_cow_data, so the published ESP exploit path is not present; fix flag loss defensively.
Keep 4.9 BH locking and acquire selected listener reference before list unlock. Phone RFCOMM remains disabled.
Keep 4.9 BH locks; no sleeping lock_sock under a spinlock. Apply reference acquisition to ready, disconnect and receive paths; clear conn->sk before last put.

series.description: SUSFS complete hash keys and request ownership
series.adaptation: Check full inode keys; validate fixed-size strings; serialize first cmdline allocation; retire old reverse rule using its own identity.
Remove inapplicable ReKernel coalescing: wrong queue branch, no TF_UPDATE_TXN opt-in or sender identity. Keep reports and actual Binder/cgroup freezing.
Match VFS short-buffer semantics, including exact-length buffers; do not append a NUL.

series.description: BBRv3 complete Reno fallback on allocation failure
series.adaptation: Use Reno cong_avoid/ssthresh callbacks so TCP core performs loss reduction and pacing; retain the existing module reference.
